title: Require Domain Model Source Topology
forbids: domain model roots outside the positive schema and policy owner topology
why: The domain-model source kind owns reusable schemas and policy. Keeping this topology separate prevents the parent domain rule from recursively recreating child-kind authority.
remediate: Keep reusable schemas in the schema owner and semantic policy in the policy owner; move every other child to its actual owner or delete it.
message: Domain model roots must match the positive domain-model blueprint spine.
